Space shuttle enters a circular portal, leading to scene with planets and silhouettes in windows.

storylines.description: A call for greater inclusion and support for researchers from all backgrounds in open science. It argues that amplifying diverse voices is essential for scientific progress and improving the world.

content_metadata.title: PLOS - Amplify Our Voices

trimmingSuggestions.description: The initial silence before the voiceover could be shortened for a more impactful opening.
The logo screen could appear slightly earlier as the music fades to maintain a dynamic pace.

text_to_speech: Dear PLOS, We are the researchers of today who come from all backgrounds and regions of this world, and we want to know: How will you include us? How will you support us? How will you amplify our voices - all of our voices - so we can change the world of tomorrow? Let’s grow our presence in all places and spaces. Let’s bring equitable and accessible research to the forefront of our communities. And let’s recognize every way, and everywhere we practice. We’re calling on you to bring our individual, boundary breaking, and mind awakening perspectives together to transform the future, and to make space for more names in Open Science. Because when all voices are heard, we can make science stronger, and improve the world of tomorrow.

youtube_description: PLOS is fueled by thousands of researchers working across time zones, career stages, and disciplines to evaluate, share, and improve science. We want to make sure every voice has the opportunity to be heard, so that we can learn from each other, find new ways to collaborate with one another, and build better ways to communicate research.
youtube_title: Science is stronger when we work together
